show.description: Single Mother follows Neha, a strong yet struggling woman who moves to Mumbai with her son to rebuild her life. Between surviving odd jobs, facing prejudice, and protecting her dignity, she crosses paths with Aman and his grandfather Baldev, unknowingly stepping into a storm of love, lies, and betrayal that will test her courage and heart.
